tools.name: analyze_niche_gap
tools.description: Analyze an SEO keyword to find search intent, industry must-haves, and content gaps using real SERP data from TheNicheGap. Use this to help craft highly differentiated articles.

keyword.description: The target SEO keyword to analyze (e.g., 'best standing desk').

locale.description: The language locale code for the analysis (e.g., 'en', 'zh'). Defaults to 'en'.
